capabilities: Open a base view when clicking a folder in the file explorer
Scope the base's contents to the clicked folder
Assign a default Index Base and per-folder base overrides
Configure which click (single, double, or Cmd/Ctrl) triggers the view
Create a recommended Index Base from settings in one click
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13+). The README's Releasing section is developer-facing and unrelated to usage.
problem: Bases normally needs a note or manual setup to show a folder's contents as a table; there is no way to click a folder and see its contents rendered through a base.

relations.evidence: Obsidian 1.13+ (desktop) with the core Bases plugin enabled.

summary: File explorer extension that opens a folder as a Bases-powered table of contents scoped to that folder, with no companion note needed.
